problemCases.expectation: The Repository export-prefix rule is violated by formatCarrierReference.
The Repository named-export rule is violated by the default service-level export used by dispatch creation.
The Repository built-in import rule is violated because fs/promises omits the node: prefix.
The Repository immutable-export rule is violated by the mutable reviewerCapabilityDeliveryStages array.
The Repository boolean-naming rule is violated by reviewerCapabilityOrderReady.
The Repository error-cause rule is violated when loading a carrier policy replaces the caught error without preserving cause.
Courier assignment mutates the caller-supplied dispatch; prepared dispatches are frozen, so the fulfillment dispatch entry throws TypeError instead of returning the dispatched order.
The Repository clock-injection rule is violated when dispatch marking reads Date.now directly.
Stock quantity adjustment inside reservation preparation uses opaque r and v parameter names, obscuring how the requested quantity changes the reservation record.
Customer and recipient normalization duplicate the same pipeline across order preparation and notification delivery.

Order preparation keeps the incoming carrierId for stock reservation and later release while dispatch independently selects a carrier by service level, so one fulfillment can reserve and release inventory for a different carrier than it dispatches.
Warehouse, order, and carrier identifiers travel together through both stock reservation and release operations.
Dispatch approval and carrier trust are encoded together in one colon-delimited decisionCode primitive.
Order state labels and cancellation policy repeat switches over the same state variants.
Adding a delivery service level requires coordinated edits to delivery-day, fee, and notification-label switches in three Modules.
reviewerCapabilityDescribeDeliveryHandling combines invoice formatting, retry timing, and locale direction policies that evolve for unrelated reasons.
Stock reservation preparation accepts an optional reservationMapper although the current order flow has no reservation mapping need.
Dispatch request construction reaches through checkout, order, customer, profile, and address to obtain a region.
The order-store wrapper only forwards load, save, and remove while order preparation depends on that indirection.
ReadOnlyOrderStore inherits save and remove but rejects both inherited operations when the order service constructs its read-only view.

Dispatch authorization is independently implemented in reviewerCapabilityCanDispatch and reviewerCapabilityCreateDispatchDecision().canDispatch, so approval or trust policy changes can drift between the two implementations.
Dispatch creation and resolved dispatch separately construct and freeze the same orderId and region request, requiring coordinated changes to the request shape or construction policy.
